mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 68 degrees with overcast skies over Badger Prairie County Park. We have a full moon tonight and the ISS will be passing overhead, but you will not be able to see it due to the cloud cover.

City officials remind us that Hwy M will be closed from October 5 through October 7 for road work near the Aldi site, and fall leaf collection also begins on October 5, so remember to keep those piles behind the curb.

There is a lot happening in our community, including live music at Baileys Run and the Verona Fall Fest today at Hometown USA Festival Park, followed by the Dane County Farmers Market tomorrow at the Capitol Square.
In a noteworthy update, on September 5, officers investigated a series of incidents where vehicles were pranked with cheese slices on their windshields throughout several city streets.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy our flavor of the day, Turtle Dove. We are open until 11:00 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
